instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Salt extraction and refining facility producing 25,000 tons of industrial and food-grade salt annually from marine evaporation pans. Weather-dependent production cycles create forecasting challenges. Evaluating brine concentration sensors and automated crystallization monitoring. We have a dedicated management team across core functions but operate with limited middle management layers. Budget cycles are annual with moderate flexibility for mid-year reallocation if a strong business case is presented. Innovation initiatives compete with day-to-day operational demands for team attention.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

input.changes_since_last: Regulatory changes forced compliance reviews. 7 new standard procedures implemented. Team morale improving.

opportunities.title: Develop Adjacent Value Propositions for Diversification
opportunities.rationale: The strategic goal explicitly demands identifying new value propositions outside the legacy business model due to industry decline. This is a bold shift required to survive structural pressures.

first_actions: 1. Conduct market gap analysis focusing on adjacent high-growth sectors (e.g., specialized industrial salts, brine tech services).
2. Establish a small cross-functional task force dedicated solely to long-term strategic pipeline identification.
3. Map regulatory compliance requirements for potential new business models immediately.
resources_needed: Internal Management time allocation (min 10% of senior staff)
execution_plan.success_metric: Number of viable adjacent market opportunities identified and scored.
milestones: M1: Finalized Adjacent Market Landscape Report (3 months).
M2: Proof-of-Concept viability study for top 2 concepts (6 months).

opportunities.title: Implement Targeted Sensor Monitoring for Operational Efficiency
opportunities.rationale: Addressing the need for better forecasting and operational control via brine concentration sensors aligns with Digital Maturity progression (from 1 to 2) while mitigating weather-dependent production risks.

first_actions: 1. Audit existing sensor data infrastructure readiness against high regulatory compliance standards.
2. Prioritize a pilot project focusing on one critical evaporation pan area for automated crystallization monitoring.
3. Integrate sensor data output directly into the owner-alone decision-making dashboard.
resources_needed: Small IoT/Sensor hardware budget (utilizing 1% annual allocation)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in forecasting variance or increase in operational uptime by X%.
milestones: M1: Sensor pilot installation and data baseline established (3 months).
M2: Operational efficiency report demonstrating KPI improvement (6 months).

next_steps.action: Finalize and approve the strategic prioritization matrix linking regulatory compliance to diversification opportunities.
Allocate dedicated, protected time for the senior engineer's innovation activities, explicitly separating operational demands from R&D work.
Draft a formal proposal outlining how incremental digital investments (opp_digital_optimization) can provide immediate budget justification during the annual cycle.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated, protected time for innovation activities due to operational demands.
Informal innovation process leading to inconsistent tool adoption and lack of structured change management.
Primary barrier remains high-level strategy formulation linking operations directly to new market value propositions.

improvements: Successfully implemented 7 new standard procedures in response to regulatory changes, improving compliance foundation.
Morale within the core team shows signs of improvement due to procedural clarity.
persistent_gaps: Structured process for ideation and proposal vetting (currently informal).
Bridging the gap between operational constraints and strategic diversification goals.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Maturity improved from informal/low digital to structured process foundation (Score 5.0). Regulatory compliance steps have been initiated, stabilizing the environment but highlighting severe strategic and resource constraints.
